title: Pinned technicians can only be reordered among the pinned technicians
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders (Approved): lead Ana — "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co"; lead Ben — "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Charlie Co"; lead Cal — "ZZAUTOTEST Delta Co".
  7. Pin Ana and then Ben: Work Orders > Board View > click the pin button in each column header (tooltip "Pin column"). The order is now Unassigned, Ana, Ben (pinned), Cal, Dan.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Write down each column header count (with the example data: Ana 1, Ben 2, Cal 1, Dan 0).
  5. Drag Ben's column (by its header drag handle) before Ana's column and release.
  6. Drag Ben's column to after Cal's column (outside the pinned area) and release there.
  7. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  8. Try to drag Ana's group header below Cal's group and release there.
  9. Read every header count again, then open the Bravo Co work order and read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: Ben moves before Ana. The order is Unassigned, Ben, Ana, Cal, Dan.
  • Step 6: Ben cannot leave the pinned area. He stays among the pinned technicians and Cal and Dan stay after them.
  • Step 8: in Tech View the pinned groups come right after Unassigned, in the same pinned order, and Ana cannot be dropped among the unpinned groups.
  • Step 9: the counts are unchanged (Ana 1, Ben 2, Cal 1, Dan 0) and Bravo Co still has Lead Technician Ben Bravo: moving technicians changed no work order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R9, S9-R10, S2-R17, read 8 Oct 2026. Design screen Board View: pin button tooltip "Pin column", drag handle tooltip "Drag to reorder technicians".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9: “Allow pinned technicians to reorder only within the pinned area.”
  • S9-R10: “Reordering technicians does not change work order assignments.”
  • S2-R17: “Tech View orders pinned technicians the same way as Board View: after the fixed Unassigned group and before unpinned technicians, each newly pinned technician after the existing pins (S3-R15, S3-R16).”
